title: land pushes an auto-merging code merge request before the item's own checks run
goal: On the code lane, backlog.py land runs the item's checks (and a bug's repro) before sync --push opens the auto-merging code/<id> request, stopping at step checks when one fails; a TestBacklogLand test plants a failing check on a code item and asserts nothing was pushed
